import importlib.util, json, numpy as np
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.optimize import linprog
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("planner","/app/submission/planner.py")
pl=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(pl)
req={"epoch":7,"node_count":2,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4},{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4}],
     "commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":4,"paths":[[0],[1]],"previous":[16,0]}],
     "failed_edges":[0],"budget":0}
pr=pl.parse_request(json.dumps(req).encode()); model=pl.Model(pr)
R,K,n = model.R, model.K, model.n
blocks=[model.A_ub.T.tocsc()]
if K and model.A_eq is not None: blocks.append(model.A_eq.T.tocsc())
mat=sparse.hstack(blocks, format="csc")
row=np.zeros(R+K+1); row[:R]=model.b_ub; row[R:R+K]=model.b_eq; row[R+K]=-1.0
A_eq_f=sparse.csc_matrix(row.reshape(1,-1))
obj=np.zeros(R+K+1); obj[R+K]=-1.0
vb=[(-1e6,0.0)]*R+[(-1e6,1e6)]*K+[(1.0,1e6)]
res=linprog(obj, A_ub=mat, b_ub=np.zeros(n), A_eq=A_eq_f, b_eq=np.array([0.0]), bounds=vb, method="highs")
print("status",res.status, res.message)
print("x",res.x if res.x is not None else None)
PYEOF
